projects.name: Retail CBDC, Wholesale CBDC, RBI Samadhan.
details: Gathered and documented business requirements  into BRDs, FRDs, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, and Process Flows for Corporate
Banking and Payment solutions.
Analyzed and optimized Cash Management processes, including SWIFT payments, domestic payments, collections, reconciliation,
settlement, liquidity, and transaction lifecycle management .
Defined business rules, workflow logic, REST API integration requirements, and exception handling for banking and payment platforms.
Collaborated with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, developers, QA teams, and banking partners to deliver enterprise payment
solutions.
Conducted requirement workshops, stakeholder interviews, gap analysis, impact analysis, and AS-IS/TO-BE process modeling.
Managed UAT, prepared test scenarios, validated payment workflows, and coordinated defect resolution for successful production releases.
Performed Root Cause Analysis (RCA), production support, and incident management to ensure system stability and business continuity.
Supported Agile/Scrum delivery by refining user stories, prioritizing backlogs, and defining acceptance criteria.
Contributed to Corporate Banking and Cash Management transformation, supporting SWIFT, STP, payment modernization, reconciliation,
settlement, and digital banking initiatives.
UST: Digital Transformation Solutions Company

projects.name: HDFC Developer Portal
details: Contributed to the implementation of Corporate Banking solutions, enabling SWIFT payment processing, cross-border payments, and secure
financial messaging.
Designed end-to-end SWIFT payment workflows covering payment initiation, MT/MX message processing, validation, sanctions screening,
reconciliation, and settlement.
Prepared BRDs, FRDs, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, Process Flows , and Functional Specifications, ensuring clear requirements and timely
delivery.
Streamlined corporate client onboarding, SWIFT connectivity, beneficiary management, and payment authorization workflows to improve
operational efficiency.
Supported integration with SWIFT Network, Core Banking Systems, REST APIs, ISO 20022, OAuth 2.0, API Security, and JWT
authentication.
Performed AS-IS/TO-BE analysis, collaborated with business and technology teams, and supported UAT, SIT, production releases, and defect
management in an Agile (Scrum) environment.
Worked with Compliance, Risk, AML, and Sanctions Screening teams to ensure regulatory compliance and improve Straight-Through Processing (STP) and payment turnaround time (TAT).
Rego Digital Solutions

projects.name: GLOW (Loan Sourcing) and Trucell (Collections) applications
details: Produced comprehensive Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), User Stories, Functional
Specifications, and Acceptance Criteria , enabling accurate solution design and successful implementation of corporate banking and payment
solutions.
Led business analysis for Corporate Banking, SWIFT Payments, and Cross-Border Payment initiatives, translating business requirements into detailed functional specifications and process flows.
Performed requirements elicitation, stakeholder workshops, AS-IS/TO-BE analysis, process mapping, and gap analysis to optimize
corporate payment processing, trade finance, and cash management workflows.
Collaborated with business stakeholders, operations, compliance, QA, and development teams to deliver enhancements across SWIFT MT/MX
messaging, cross-border payments, RTGS, NEFT, and corporate payment platforms using Agile methodologies.
Defined and validated business rules for SWIFT payment lifecycle, including payment initiation, message validation, authorization, routing,
settlement, reconciliation, exception handling, and repair processes.
Managed User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect triage, production releases, and Go-Live support, ensuring high-quality deployments with
minimal business disruption.

Improved operational efficiency by optimizing payment processing, reconciliation, exception management, and straight-through processing (STP), reducing turnaround time and improving transaction accuracy.
Developed MIS reports, operational dashboards, and business insights to monitor payment volumes, transaction status, reconciliation,
operational KPIs, and regulatory reporting.
Successfully delivered end-to-end implementations  for Corporate Banking Payment Systems, SWIFT Integration, Cash Management, and
Cross-Border Payment Solutions, ensuring timely delivery and stakeholder satisfaction.
Worked closely with compliance teams to ensure adherence to SWIFT standards (MT/MX), ISO 20022, AML, Sanctions Screening, FATF, RBI,
and international payment regulations, maintaining regulatory compliance across payment operations.
Supported continuous process improvement initiatives by identifying automation opportunities, reducing manual interventions, enhancing
payment processing efficiency, and improving customer experience.
The Four Walls Properties
